summary: HAPPY-PATH verification of live Google Maps integration after user enabled Places API (New), Geocoding, Distance Matrix and set application restrictions to 'None'. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. /api/maps/autocomplete?q=connaught%20place%20delhi returned provider='google' with real ChIJ... placeIds; /api/maps/autocomplete?q=mumbai%20central and 'india gate delhi' likewise returned live Google suggestions. /api/maps/distance-km?origin=Mumbai&destination=Pune returned provider='google', 147.91 km, duration_text populated with 'hour'/'min' (matches E1's expectation ~140-170 km). Cross-test with real ChIJ placeIds also returned provider='google' with positive distance_km and duration_text. Server-side fare recalculation verified for the exact scenario in the request: POST /api/bookings distance_km=10, vehicle_type=tata_ace → fare=200.00 ✓ (also two_wheeler 3.5→35.0, bada_dost 2.0→60.0, invalid vehicle rejected 400). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 390x844: typed 'connaught place delhi' in PICKUP → pickup-suggestions dropdown appeared with 5 real Google suggestions (first testID pickup-suggestion-ChIJV9BBtzf9DDkR8cOTc-SI7s0), selected it; typed 'india gate delhi' in DROP-OFF → 5 suggestions (first testID dropoff-suggestion-ChIJk-MbltviDDkRrhDd5l7vx_Y). Fare summary populated with DISTANCE=4.87 KM, ETA=12 MINS, TOTAL=₹48.70 (real Google-calculated route). BOOK-NOW enabled (aria-disabled=None). Filled name='Test User', phone='9876543210', tapped CONFIRM → success modal with booking ID 204EE4E1, VEHICLE=TWO-WHEELER, DISTANCE=4.87 KM, FARE=₹48.70. Backend logs show ZERO new 403/permission_denied/request_denied errors after the user's fix (existing errors in log are timestamped 17:30–17:31, prior to fix; current run at 18:44+ is clean). React Native issues detected: TouchableWithoutFeedback deprecation warning still present (BookingFormModal, line 563).

react_native_issues.issue: TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated; React Native emits warning at runtime. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:563. Replace with Pressable wrapping the Keyboard.dismiss handler.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in BookingFormModal (index.tsx:563) with Pressable to silence the deprecation warning.

OPTIONAL UX: On small viewports (<=390px height with keyboard) the CONFIRM button in the booking modal can fall outside the visible area — consider wrapping modal body in a ScrollView so users can scroll to reach it. Test still passed after scroll_into_view.
critical_code_review_comments: Google Maps integration is production-ready: provider='google' returned for all endpoints, no OSM fallback anywhere in server.py.
Real ChIJ... placeIds are now returned by autocomplete and correctly consumed by distance-km via the _fmt() helper.
Server-side fare = round(distance_km * VEHICLE_RATES[vehicle_type], 2) — ignores client-supplied fare (secure).
Rates confirmed correct: two_wheeler=10, tata_ace=20, bada_dost=30.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ bookings + 1 real booking (Test User, TWO-WHEELER, Connaught Place → India Gate, 4.87 km, ₹48.70) via full E2E flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Maps API key is fully unlocked as of this iteration. Real ChIJ placeIds return from /api/maps/autocomplete, and /api/maps/distance-km returns real road distances (Mumbai→Pune=147.91 km, Connaught Place→India Gate=4.87 km). No further Google-restriction issues expected. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py verifies provider='google', ChIJ-style placeIds, realistic distance ranges, and duration_text presence — will fail loudly if Google reverts to restricted state.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verified working end-to-end with live Google Maps data.
